dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have time for a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Sure. Found anything interesting on your recent adventures?

choices.text: I found some more treasure chests...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Oh, that's wonderful! For us adventurers, there's no better way to pay the bills than finding a chest or two!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Take me. If I relied solely on my income as a consultant for the Adventurers' Guild, who knows how long it would take to save up for my own research vessel...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: However, I have to be careful when opening chests to make sure Lumi doesn't swallow whatever's inside.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I really don't know where she picked up this habit of swallowing every shiny thing she sees.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Though come to think of it... There is a legend about Crystal Beetles that says they started carrying solid Phlogiston around as a way to make themselves stand out...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: So maybe the reason Lumi swallows shiny things isn't because she's hungry...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: ...But rather because she's collecting decorations, hoping to wear them one day and be accepted by the other Jack Frosts.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: I'll make sure to feed her more next time! It's just a few chunks of ore, after all. As long as I keep finding more chests, I can always replace them later.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Ruins that rarely see visitors tend to develop their own unique ecosystems. They're truly fascinating places!

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: That said, the traps and monsters inside aren't quite so charming...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Things like Primal Constructs and Secret Source Automatons aren't much of an issue, but Clockwork Meka... Ugh, just thinking about them sends shivers down my spine.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: The Fontaine Research Institute is such a terrifying place... To think they created so many of those things, all with their own different functions...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But I must admit, the dance of Coppelia and Coppelius is truly captivating, like watching a performance on the stage... though I made sure to enjoy it from a distance.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, do you prefer the Icewind Suite or Knuckle Duckle?

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: Knuckle Duckle, of course! It's so much cuter, and can even handle basic conversations. Besides, if pressed, I'd say it's not entirely without its practical applications.

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: But most importantly, Aino invented it...

response.speaker: Linnea
response.text: What are you laughing at? So what if I'm biased towards my friends?
